# Miranda Rae Photography

> Affordable Florida Gulf Coast beach photographer. Miranda Rae photographs families, couples, maternity, engagements, proposals and small beach weddings in a relaxed, lightly guided style. Every session is shot and edited by Miranda personally.

- Website: https://mirandaraephotography.com/
- Photographer: Miranda Rae
- Email: bookmirandarae@gmail.com
- Phone/text: (448) 219-6539
- Photo gallery: https://mirandaraephotography.com/gallery
- Facebook (18 reviews, 96% recommend): https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61591669718246

## Service areas
Mexico Beach, Port St. Joe, Cape San Blas, Indian Pass, Panama City Beach, Destin, St. George Island, and 30A (Santa Rosa Beach, Seaside, Rosemary Beach, WaterColor), Florida.

## Prices
Full price list: https://mirandaraephotography.com/prices
<!--prices:llms-->
- Beach Mini Session (Mexico Beach, Port St. Joe, Cape San Blas, Panama City Beach) — $130: 30 min, 15 edited photos, up to 6 people.
- Beach Special (Classic Session) (Destin, 30A, St. George Island) — $199: 45–60 min, 30–35 edited photos, up to 11 people, 1 location, 1 outfit change.
- Family Session — $250: 45–60 min, 35+ edited photos, up to 15 people, 1 location.
- Deluxe Session — $325: 75+ min, 50+ edited photos, 2 locations, 2 outfit changes.
- Engagement Session — $199: Up to 1 hour, 35+ edited photos.
- Surprise Proposal — $199: 30 edited photos.
- Beach Wedding (Riviera Collection) — $499: Up to 4 hours, ceremony, family photos & shoreline portraits.
- Wedding: Étoile Collection — $799: 6 hours.
- Wedding: Grand Coastal Collection — $1,500: 10 hours.
- Extras: extra person (over the package limit) $15 each; extra edited photo $10 each; extra session time $30 per 20 min; rush editing (24–48 hours) $50.
- Travel: $30 travel fee for Destin, 30A & St. George Island.
- A $50 non-refundable deposit holds your date and comes off the session price.
<!--/prices:llms-->
- Last-minute sessions are sometimes available — text to ask. All sessions include a private online gallery.

## Booking
Checking a date is free with no payment required. Send your beach and dates through the form at https://mirandaraephotography.com/#check-date and Miranda replies personally to confirm availability, meeting spot and time.
